name: agent-ks
description: Teaches an AI agent to operate an agent-knowledge-system project: docs and blog posts, the folder-per-issue tracker (plans, subtasks, agent logs, agent memory), and self-contained HTML artifacts. Ten skills, three of them commands (config, quick-idea-note, index-check), and the agent-ks CLI. Requires bun.

interface.shortDescription: Docs, blog and issue-tracker skills for agent-knowledge-system projects
